scope: Current upload-folder inventory; purposes were reviewed file by file. Excludes only this inventory itself.

.gitignore.purpose: Excludes environments, caches, upstream downloads and newly generated runs from version control.

CITATION.cff.purpose: Machine-readable software and upstream-data citations for GitHub.

LICENSE.purpose: License for the original evaluation code.

README.md.purpose: Entry point: experimental setup, downloads, code map, reproducible commands and code/data license scope.

THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.purpose: Attribution and license scope of dataset-derived records and upstream software.

analyze_sweep.py.purpose: Verifies the complete saved sweep and generates the paper report, numerical macros, CSV plot data and Figure 3 through plot_sweep.py.

benchmark.py.purpose: Shared orchestration, candidate upload baseline, construction/matching result checks, count aggregation and reports; imported by sweep, instance preparation and both benchmark verifiers.

docs/EXPERIMENT.md.purpose: Matching budgets, measured quantities, recorded findings and interpretation limits.

docs/MANUAL_REVIEW.md.purpose: Concrete observations, rules and result records for a reviewer to check by hand.

docs/SOURCES.md.purpose: Dataset, classifier and prior-log sources, with citations and optional input-rebuilding instructions.

docs/coupling/README.md.purpose: Explanation of synthetic inter-case rows, merge hierarchy, source placement and saved evidence.

docs/coupling/assets/endpoint_choices.sv.purpose: Checked visual example of one nonredundant inter-case exclusion.

docs/reviewer/DATA_DICTIONARY.md.purpose: Definitions of descriptive statistics and generated table columns.

docs/reviewer/README.md.purpose: GitHub-readable data preparation, GT/uncertain-log statistics and rule-mining guide.

docs/reviewer/RULES.md.purpose: Readable catalogue of mined and selected constraints, including exact semantics and witnesses.

docs/reviewer/artifact_manifest.json.purpose: Integrity inventory for the generated guide, tables, figures and downloads.

docs/reviewer/assets/activity_profile.sv.purpose: GT activity frequencies and candidate support used in the data guide.

docs/reviewer/assets/data_pipeline.svg.purpose: Visual explanation of the original scores, GT segmentation and candidate policy.

docs/reviewer/assets/log_profiles.svg.purpose: GT trace and uncertainty distributions supporting the guide.

docs/reviewer/assets/rule_mining.svg.purpose: Visual explanation of prerequisite and occurrence-bound discovery.

docs/reviewer/assets/rule_support.svg.purpose: Visual support comparison for mined and selected rules.

docs/reviewer/data/activities.csv.purpose: Activity-level GT frequencies, candidate counts and score summaries.

docs/reviewer/data/cases.csv.purpose: Per-case GT and uncertain-log descriptive measurements.

docs/reviewer/data/groups.csv.purpose: Descriptive measurements for each furniture group.

docs/reviewer/data/log_stats.json.purpose: Complete descriptive statistics derived independently from the prepared logs.

docs/reviewer/data/model_comparison.csv.purpose: Classifier comparison underlying the choice of P3D.

docs/reviewer/data/observations.csv.purpose: Per-observation identity, interval, candidate and GT-insertion statistics for manual inspection.

docs/reviewer/data/occurrence_bounds.csv.purpose: Empirical activity counts and selected occurrence-bound indicators.

docs/reviewer/data/prerequisite_tests.cs.purpose: All 992 activity-pair prerequisite tests, including rejected pairs.

docs/reviewer/data/prerequisites.csv.purpose: Detailed support and selection status of mined prerequisite constraints.

docs/reviewer/data/rule_stats.json.purpose: Independent mining audit, rule statistics and links to concrete witnesses.

docs/reviewer/data/score_distributions.c.purpose: Score summaries by retained candidate rank.

docs/reviewer/data/transitions.csv.purpose: GT directly-follows activity counts for inspecting the reference process.

docs/reviewer/data/variants.csv.purpose: GT case variants and their frequencies.

docs/reviewer/downloads/USAGE.txt.purpose: Standard event-log attribute mappings and PM4Py loading examples.

docs/reviewer/downloads/ground_truth.csv.purpose: Downloadable GT events with standard case/activity/time columns.

docs/reviewer/downloads/ground_truth.xes.purpose: Downloadable standard XES view of the GT events.

docs/reviewer/downloads/ikea-asm-event-l.purpose: Convenience download containing both event logs in CSV/XES and their import instructions.

docs/reviewer/downloads/manifest.json.purpose: Input/output hashes, attribute conventions and validation of the downloadable logs.

docs/reviewer/downloads/uncertain_log.cs.purpose: Downloadable uncertain events with standard columns and original probs_json payload.

docs/reviewer/downloads/uncertain_log.xe.purpose: Downloadable compressed XES with standard fields and original candidate scores.

docs/reviewer/index.html.purpose: Offline searchable view of the data guide, with local vector figures.

docs/reviewer/provenance.json.purpose: Generator hashes for the delivered data guide.

examples/paper_example.json.purpose: Small concrete paper model used by the integration test to compare central/distributed construction and exact matching.

inputs/provenance/original_instance.json.purpose: Original full-73-rule instance required to validate the frozen merge plan, rebuild exact source placements and audit the endpoint witness; not an unused pilot result.

inputs/provenance/plan_seed0.json.gz.purpose: Exact synthetic inter-case constraints, endpoint witnesses, observation owners and source hosts reused across the grid.

inputs/provenance/selected_instance.json.purpose: Recorded five-rule reference instance used by sweep preparation and verify_sweep to establish the reduced model matches the fixed retry.

inputs/provenance/selection_protocol.jso.purpose: Frozen rule selection and ranking policy with GT hash; needed by preparation, guide regeneration and verifiers.

inputs/provenance/support_rankings.json.purpose: Complete support rankings independently rechecked by the rule guide; documents why these three prerequisites and two bounds were chosen.

inputs/reference/artifact_manifest.json.purpose: Original prepared-input hash inventory required by verify.py. Deleting listed input files would invalidate this frozen record.

inputs/reference/candidate_replacements..purpose: All GT candidate insertions with original scores and discarded alternative; necessary to audit selection and regenerate uncertain-log statistics.

inputs/reference/full/candidate_coverage.purpose: Per-observation GT inclusion/rank, independently checked against the uncertain log by verify.py.

inputs/reference/full/candidate_policy.j.purpose: Authoritative three-candidate, GT insertion, no-renormalization policy and activity vocabulary; consumed by preparation loading, input verifier and statistics.

inputs/reference/full/cases.csv.purpose: Case roster and recording metadata required by instance construction, interval validation, all log statistics and verification.

inputs/reference/full/constraint_audit.j.purpose: Every accepted/rejected prerequisite test and count bound; enables independent exhaustive mining audit and rule catalogue.

inputs/reference/full/constraints.json.purpose: All 73 original mined templates; needed to validate original plan before applying the selected five-rule subset.

inputs/reference/full/ground_truth.csv.purpose: Authoritative GT event identity, activity and interval table required for all input/constraint/instance regeneration and verification.

inputs/reference/full/ground_truth.xes.purpose: Frozen GT export verified independently by verify.py and transformed into the portable download format by reviewer/event_logs.py; not byte-identical to current user-facing download.

inputs/reference/full/occurrence_bounds..purpose: Small human-readable mined bound table and part of the immutable preparation inventory; supports direct manual review.

inputs/reference/full/occurrence_counts_.purpose: Per-case per-activity GT counts used by reviewer/log_stats.py for independent validation and available for manual rule review.

inputs/reference/full/prerequisite_witne.purpose: Concrete GT predecessor witnesses for every accepted trigger, independently verified by verify.py.

inputs/reference/full/prerequisites.csv.purpose: Small human-readable accepted prerequisite list with support and vacuity information; part of frozen preparation evidence.

inputs/reference/full/uncertain_log.csv..purpose: Authoritative uncertain observations and exact original score strings used by the sweep, input checks, statistics and downloads.

inputs/reference/full/uncertain_log.xes..purpose: Frozen uncertain XES checked independently and transformed into the standard-attribute public download; original scores/observations must be preserved.

inputs/reference/model_selection.csv.purpose: Human-readable ten-model accuracy comparison; also directly read by reviewer/diagrams.py.

inputs/reference/model_selection.json.purpose: Detailed model/frame counts, selection metric and per-case evidence used to regenerate and independently check model statistics.

inputs/reference/protocol.json.purpose: Preparation options and 25-fps clock convention required for guide statistics and portable event-log exports.

inputs/reference/source_audit.json.purpose: Pinned upstream/log agreement, original cases and empty-case exclusion; used by the guide and data audit.

inputs/reference/summary.json.purpose: Recorded preparation population, rule and variant summaries used by reviewer diagrams and covered by the frozen manifest.

minea_ikea/__init__.py.purpose: Package boundary for the experiment implementation.

minea_ikea/construction.py.purpose: Distributed matching-model construction implementation used by benchmark and sweep.

minea_ikea/data.py.purpose: Pinned export download/hash checks, model ranking and GT-aligned input preparation, used by run.py and tests.

minea_ikea/exports.py.purpose: Writes auditable CSV/XES prepared inputs and mining outputs, used by run.py and preparation tests.

minea_ikea/instances.py.purpose: Loads exact original score tokens, constructs source placements and inter-case exclusions, and validates merge plans; used in sweep preparation and offline audits.

minea_ikea/matching.py.purpose: Central and distributed matching implementations measured by the study.

minea_ikea/mining.py.purpose: Mines GT prerequisites and occurrence bounds from prepared event intervals; used by input rebuilding and tests.

minea_ikea/reference.py.purpose: Independent central row encoding, component partitioning, feasibility and small-instance brute-force oracle; required by verifiers and benchmark.

minea_ikea/solver.py.purpose: Exact rational Z3 optimization and certification boundary used by both matching methods.

paper_output/ikea_sweep/REPORT.md.purpose: Reviewer-facing report of measurements and limitations.

paper_output/ikea_sweep/components.csv.purpose: Readable per-component outcomes, exact bounds and component order used in manual figure checks.

paper_output/ikea_sweep/construction.csv.purpose: Readable 32-condition structural and coordination counts used in manual figure checks.

paper_output/ikea_sweep/evaluation.tex.purpose: Exact paper evaluation fragment retained to bind artifacts to manuscript claims.

paper_output/ikea_sweep/figure_provenanc.purpose: Figure renderer, source-code and construction-manifest hashes.

paper_output/ikea_sweep/figure_reproduct.purpose: Evidence that regenerated vector content and pixels match retained paper figure.

paper_output/ikea_sweep/figures/ikea-ove.purpose: Editable vector source of paper Figure 3.

paper_output/ikea_sweep/matching.csv.purpose: Readable 40 matching-job results, terminations and work counters.

paper_output/ikea_sweep/overview_data.js.purpose: Exact Figure 3 series, averaging and grouped-curve evidence.

paper_output/ikea_sweep/summary.json.purpose: JSON view of the published construction and matching tables; useful machine-readable output despite CSV overlap.

paper_output/ikea_sweep/verification.jso.purpose: Recorded independent offline verification; regeneration also produces a fresh report.

plot_sweep.py.purpose: Draws publication Figure 3 as vector PDF/PGF with manuscript fonts; required by analyze_sweep.py.

provenance/README.md.purpose: Explains the current release evidence and how to inspect it.

provenance/extraction.json.purpose: Original copy provenance, including hashes before standalone portability edits.

provenance/paper_sources.json.purpose: Identity of the manuscript and figures used to create this standalone artifact.

provenance/recorded_endpoint_audit.json.purpose: Recorded-code comparison and all 115 single-replacement feasibility checks.

provenance/release_tests.log.purpose: Output of all 178 automated tests run on the cleaned release.

provenance/release_validation.json.purpose: Consolidated current release checks, cleanup decisions and verification limits.

provenance/standard_event_log_validation.purpose: Versioned PM4Py import checks whose exported-file hashes still match this release.

references.bib.purpose: Reusable BibTeX references for the dataset and related work.

requirements-figures.txt.purpose: Pins optional Matplotlib for paper figures and descriptive guide plots, separate from the matching environment.

requirements.txt.purpose: Pins the Z3 solver version used by matching and solver-dependent tests; preparation and offline verification remain standard-library code.

results/benchmark_sweep/artifact_manifes.purpose: Closed inventory required by sweep verification.

results/benchmark_sweep/construction/REP.purpose: Original readable construction report; manifest-bound, not computationally consumed.

results/benchmark_sweep/construction/art.purpose: Exact closed inventory required by verifier and hashed in figure provenance.

results/benchmark_sweep/preparation/plan.purpose: Frozen full-model merge plan, used by full independent plan validation.

results/benchmark_sweep/preparation/prov.purpose: Input/protocol hashes and dataset lineage, historical absolute paths are not dependencies.

results/benchmark_sweep/preparation/sele.purpose: Five-template fixed selection provenance checked by verifier.

results/benchmark_sweep/preparation/vali.purpose: Recorded preparation audit compared to recomputed preparation checks.

results/benchmark_sweep/progress.json.purpose: Completed runner progress summary, redundant with protocol job list/job records; no offline computational consumer.

results/benchmark_sweep/protocol.json.purpose: Grid, budgets, actual job identities, producer hashes and interpretation.

review.py.purpose: Public entry point to regenerate the data guide, statistics, diagrams and portable event-log downloads.

reviewer/coupling.py.purpose: Recreates the inter-case endpoint illustration from the exact recorded exclusion and checks the illustrated changed selection.

reviewer/diagrams.py.purpose: Generates data-preparation and rule-mining SVG diagrams; also provides drawing primitives used by coupling.py.

reviewer/event_logs.py.purpose: Generates portable XES/CSV downloads with standard process-mining attributes and unchanged score payload; preserves frozen input semantics.

reviewer/log_stats.py.purpose: Recomputes GT and uncertain-log descriptive tables and verifies their local source records.

reviewer/plots.py.purpose: Generates statistical SVG figures in the reviewer guide using the frozen prepared logs and recomputed rule counts.

reviewer/render.py.purpose: Generates the Markdown/HTML data guide and dictionary from statistics and export evidence.

reviewer/rule_stats.py.purpose: Independently recounts mined rules, ranks, candidate rows and vacuity, checks frozen evidence and writes the complete rule catalogue.

run.py.purpose: Rebuilds prepared inputs and mined rules from the pinned upstream exports; important for end-to-end reproduction beyond the included prepared inputs.

source_manifest.json.purpose: Pinned upstream paths, byte sizes and hashes used by the optional input rebuild.

sweep.py.purpose: Public entry point to prepare the 32-condition construction grid and run the 40 matching jobs, with process isolation, budgets, snapshots and manifests.

sweep_instances.py.purpose: Builds and audits the exact source/component grid using the original merge plan and the frozen five-rule selection; also imported by verify_sweep.py.

tests/test_benchmark_integration.py.purpose: Independent randomized end-to-end tests against complete enumeration.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_benchmark_review.py.purpose: Independent cross-module checks, including malformed result certificates.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_construction.py.purpose: Hand-countable executions of the logical construction protocol.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_data.py.purpose: Independent examples for the scientific data transformations (standard library only).. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_exports.py.purpose: Round-trip checks of exported clocks, labels, scores, and case membership.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_instances.py.purpose: Small semantic counterexamples and fixed-population instance invariants.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_matching.py.purpose: Paper transcript, message accounting, retained snapshots, and cutoffs.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_matching_review.py.purpose: Independent protocol review: actual emissions and interrupted certificates.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_mining.py.purpose: Small independently understood reference logs for mining semantics.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_reference.py.purpose: Hand-counted central encoding and exhaustive objective checks.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_reviewer_log_stats.py.purpose: Small, hand-counted tests of the descriptive report, independent of IKEA totals.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_reviewer_rule_stats.py.purpose: Independent miniature examples for reviewer-facing mining statistics.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_solver.py.purpose: Certification tests with a small, solver-independent binary enumeration.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_sweep_reporting.py.purpose: Reporting invariants: component interfaces, coverage and incomplete runs.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_verify.py.purpose: The separate result checker must reject incomplete or false discovered rules.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

tests/test_verify_benchmark.py.purpose: Offline benchmark verification, including corruption with recomputed hashes.. Preserve to support reproducibility and trust in the implementation.

verify.py.purpose: Independent prepared-log, candidate, rule, witness, clock and input-manifest checks; no optimizer needed.

verify_benchmark.py.purpose: Independent construction and matching checks imported by verify_sweep.py; includes semantic and small-instance checks beyond production implementation.

verify_sweep.py.purpose: Public offline audit of the frozen sweep, exact model equivalence and all recorded matching results.
